Class Locomotive

java.lang.Object
domain.Locomotive
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class Locomotive extends Object implements Serializable
Locomotive entity representing a train engine in the game Contains all properties and characteristics of train locomotives

  • Constructor Details

    • Locomotive

      public Locomotive(String modelName, int price, String type, int fuelCost, int maintenanceCost, int startYearOfOperation, int endYearOfOperation, int topSpeed)
      Creates a new Locomotive with the specified characteristics
      Parameters:
      modelName - The model name of the locomotive
      price - The purchase price of the locomotive
      type - The type of locomotive (e.g., steam, diesel, electric)
      fuelCost - The fuel cost per operation
      maintenanceCost - The maintenance cost
      startYearOfOperation - The first year this locomotive is available
      endYearOfOperation - The last year this locomotive is available
      topSpeed - The maximum speed of the locomotive
